title: Foxconn Beats Q3 Revenue Forecasts With 47.1% Growth
summary:
Hon Hai reported September sales of NT$ 1.16 trillion, an increase of 38.4% compared with the previous year. Third-quarter revenue climbed 47.1% year-over-year to NT$ 3.027 trillion, or approximately $95.4 billion, beating analyst expectations as the company saw high demand for AI servers from partners like Nvidia.

Foxconn, the common name for Hon Hai, anticipates that its AI-related operations will continue to grow in the fourth quarter, a trend signaling sustained spending on global AI infrastructure. Management cautioned that the company must monitor the impact of a volatile global political and economic environment.
